name: Pobeg v Moskvu
source:
Freelance IT specialist Semyon meet a girl from Dagestan on the Internet. However, their relationship quickly grow over the regular chatting - he decides to help her run away from home. That is how their amazing adventure begins.

The game has multiple bad endings and only one good ending - it all depends on choices you make.
What choice should you make? Which way to go towards your goal? Will you be able to win the trust of a girl living on the other side of the country? How far can you go on your way?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484960/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
自由职业IT技术人员谢苗，在网上认识了一位来自达吉斯坦的女孩。然而，两人的关系很快超越普通聊天，他决定帮助她离家出走。不可思议的冒险，就此开始。

游戏包含多个坏结局，以及唯一一个好结局，一切取决于你的选择。
该做出怎样的选择？该沿哪条路走向目标？你能赢得那个住在国家另一端的女孩的信任吗？又能为这段旅程走多远？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484960/]Steam[/url]]
